overall_assessment.conceptual_continuity: Design and evaluate process-aware multimodal industrial prediction using strong unimodal baselines, modular fusion, robustness interventions and evaluation beyond accuracy. A negative answer is still an answer to a research question.
overall_assessment.methodological_changes: PHM became provisional image-target regression and bounded sensor diagnostics; Intel was stopped at the evaluation-protection gate; REASSEMBLE added recording-disjoint annotated failure classification. RT-DETR became a frozen ResNet-backbone representation (its Transformer encoder/decoder was unused in the core), statistics replaced the tested PatchTST in core fusion, logistic stacking replaced the planned convex combination, and scalar late gates replaced any implied temporal cross-attention. The standalone gate was explicitly replaced by an incremental-information gate for Section 1B.
overall_assessment.gated_exclusions: Intel new models; audio/AST/trimodal/audio-corruption experiments; physical-object OOD; dependent PHM sensor stages after failed signal gates. None is a poor model result.
overall_assessment.SQ1: Partially answerable across the full original modality scope: visual and sensor representations tested with bounded conclusions; audio suitability unanswered.
overall_assessment.SQ2: Answerable for the tested visual/sensor family: static late fusion improves beyond statistics; original gates do not establish additional clean gain. Full originally contemplated trimodal or temporal-cross-attention scope not evaluated.
overall_assessment.SQ3: Answerable with a bounded negative for the original core gates and mixed dropout results under the declared faults. Complete-loss fallback is structural. Audio, natural faults and physical-object OOD remain outside evaluated scope.
overall_assessment.SQ4: Partially answerable: predictive/calibration metrics, component cost and diagnostics measured; human interpretability, branch replacement generalization and prospective usability untested.
overall_assessment.useful_supervisor_acknowledgement: Reconcile each row with the actual approved exposé and external master when available; acknowledge the dataset/task pivots, statistics selection, representation-not-detection use, logistic late fusion, gated exclusions, exploratory status, and separate appendix treatment of later positive adaptive results. This package does not assert that acknowledgement has occurred.
